pages.brief: Close view of Nell the bee's body, showing clear black stripe marks, wings blurred mid-buzz.
Nell the bee flying towards a large bright yellow flower bloom in a garden.
Nell the bee landing on a thin green twig just beside the bright bloom.
Nell the bee reaching into the centre of the bright yellow bloom, collecting pale yellow dust on her legs.
Nell the bee flying away from the bloom, pale yellow dust visible on her legs.
Nell the bee flying towards a cluster of other bees waiting near a tree hollow.
Nell the bee sharing the pale yellow dust from her legs with another bee.
Nell the bee flying off again above the garden, wings a blur.
Nell the bee hovering happily over the garden under a bright, clear blue sky.
